content: 22:1-14 Munon ger yamangar baiba mi aib at nubour
Yisas qob eng ende wurinob qamb wogub bo mi geret maribig qamar:
“Qenu wonou bibis big igo eng munon baraitari ger wonou wau end yamangar bateib qamb mi arsi nob nib at igo gas ende.
Mi arsi wogub wonou sarau munon imurima iua munon wurinob qamara mi at nibar end diorunor qamb qob gim bigor eng wuri me diarau.

Ende gab sarau munon bo qei wuriimuri wurinob qamar: ‘An isub ye munon wurimaribigoum eng ete wurinob qamarar: ye mi gugum mom arsi ugaum. Yonou bur qarig qamagat aib ne wai aib-aib qei gor igaramb ugab mom arsi igoum. Isub wurinob qamara diab nunor.’
Ende qamb wuriimurima isub wurinob qamamir ego munon eng tari qer igub wogub der iua uburemirei. Ger der wonou man sarau end isuor, a ger der wonou qur sarau end isorei.
A qei der munon barai wonou sarau munon gim biga ba isumir igaramb wurimumusiari umb uburemirei.
Ende abari munon barai eng oau biriberi nub wogub yogorau munon wuriimurima isub munon ginam eng sarau munon igaramir eng ginam di igaramb ugab mon mutet wab ugamirei.
Ne munon aib eng bo der wonou sarau munon qei wurinob qamar: ‘Mani mom arsiaum ereteri igo ego munon diab niar qamb wurit gim bigoum eng ue eng.
End see an bo tap tog end ne tap tog sorai end isub munon irou ibag eng wurinob qamarari yonou wau yamangar baiba mi arsiaum e diab nunor.’
Ende qamb wuriimurima isub munon boru-boru uber-uber ibagamir eng gugum wurisogar ba diab ariramari munai eng yab di qorei.
Ende igamari munon barai eng mor diab ibagar eng munon gari qas, munon yamangar baiba mi aib at nub mi goan qumani igour eng me qumanimau. Ende gab qebi qamar:
‘Ne meimet qamb mi goan eng qumani mor e me diarau?’ ende qamara munon eng qob ger me qamarau.
Ende gab munon barai sarau munon wurinob qamar: ‘Baab uben touri goten touri wogub ba ag ai itum end ariramari igoriner. Igo eab nan suab igoriner.’ “
Yisas qob ende qamb sasam mom qamar: “Qenu munon gugum wonou yurau igoarar qamb wuriqubei igo. Ego munon gari-gari wonou yurau apand igorub qamb abari eng gari wuriqubei igo.”
22:15-22 Sisar qur utau end Yisas qebiamirei
Ende qamara Parisi wurinou qiumuni qamamir: “In qob maigas qamb nausi ne Yisas baab tourimboun?”

Ende qamb Parisi wurinou imbigau yurau eng ne Herot wonou munon yurau eng ende wuriqereimari Yisast isumirei. Isub Yisas nob qamamir: “Imbigau munon, ne qob inimbig quran eng qob apand ar. Ne Qenu wonou qob ne qomon apand eng qas munon yamangar wuriimbig igoan. Ne qob qamb igoan eng munon gari gumat me qamb igoan, munon gugum wurigumar qamb igoan.
End ne ne mai misir igan? In Rom munon barai oroar igo end nomon qur bigun eng mai ininou qomon eng biisitouboun qiyo ue?”
Ende qamarari Yisas wurinou misir soagen end eng at qebimari diban ibag wogub wurinob qamar: “An munon qob qetopur qamarau tari, meimet qamb ye yewarigesi qamb igoumon?
Nomon qur bigub quraumon eng ete abari gine?” Ende qamara nomon qur eng ba utari gab
wuri qebi qamar: “Your wonou qugur unum nob nomon qur et igama gab igoumon?”
Ne wuri taui qamamir: “Rom gabman munon barai oroar igo eng.” Ne Yisas qamar: “End ne munon barai eng wonomi eng gab wonou sarau end bagatatar. A Qenu wonomi eng gab Qenu wonou begetet, ende abar.”
Ende qamara igub borumisir igub wogub Yisas end wogub qoamirei.
22:23-33 Munon umb bo der bogomau end Yisas qebiamirei
Qoari wogub qen end gari munon yurau Sadyusi qamb igour eng wuri bo Yisast yaremirei. Munon yurau eng wuri munon umb bo igomot me der bugomunorei qamb igour eng.

Yarab qebi qamamir: “Imbigau munon, Moses qob ete qamb gumaterei igama gab igoun: ‘Munon ger wonou ubeni wau ue igama umami uma ne bo umour der ubeni qindou eng wo bo baia ne wau giner eng, wau eng umami qamart eng wonou.’
End ne munon ger wonou wau 7-ende e igour. Wau qamar wonou ubeni eng wau ue igama umorei. Uma ubeni qindou eng wau yab baurei.
Eng gor wau ue igama umorei, ne wau qag eng gor ende sig. Ende at-at isii yarab wau 7 eng gugum yamangar eng gari ba wogub umb uburemirei.
Mom sasam wurinou yamangar qindou eng umorei.
End ne munon yamangar bo igomot der bugomunor qen end yamangar eng your wonou bo baiba? Gugum bo baubour qiyo?”
Yisas taui qamar: “Qenu wonou qob igo eng ne wonou qeretutnob eng an musub me imbig ne qob soagen ur eng at qamb igoumon eng.
Munon igomot der bugomunor eng gugum Qenu wonou munon qau enger nob garisi wonou ginamt end igorubour. Igo qi baiau qomon eng me igorinerei.
Munon igomot der bugomunor end Qenu aninob qamar eng an me imbig igoumon? Ete qamarei:
‘Ye Abraham Aisak ne Yekop wurinou Qenu.’ Qob eng qanam eng, bebereg qenen igamau eng wonou Qenu.”
Ende qamara munon yurau aib eng wonou qob eng igub qoaguruiamirei.
22:34-40 Qenu qomon gigit igo eng
Yisas qob qeretutnob ende qamara Sadyusi igub qob ger me qamarau. Ende abari Parisi wuri igub gugum yar Yisast qiumuniamirei.
Qiumuni ne wurinou imbigau munon ger der Yisas bo warigesierib qamb qebi qamar:
“Imbigau munon, qomon irou igo ego, meimi qomon eng qomon qei wuritanamima?”
Yisas taui qamar: “Ne Munon aib Qenu end yonou oau uri qamb ne nonou misir eng ne igom igoan eng gugum wonou wot dui wog.
Qomon eng sig aib ne uber.
Ne qomon eng igama ii igo eng ete: Nonou git goan qenunget igoan gas end munon qei wuriqenungar.
Moses qomon irou gumater eng ne munon miteri qamb gumatemir eng qomon qob qambri igour eng, qanam eng qomon ombur gari see nonob quraum eng,” ende qamarei.
22:41-46 Yisas Parisi nob agunumirei
Parisi yar qiumuniamir eng ende igamari Yisas der wuri qebi qamar:
“An munon wuriubersiau tari end an mai misir igoumon? Wo your tumbigi end dariamorei?” Ne wuri taui qamamir: “Debit tumbigi end dariamorei.”
Ende qamarari wo qamar: “Ende gab eng Igomurur qau Debit mai gas oau menima ‘yonou munon aib’ qamarei?
Ete qamarei,

content.text: Yonou munon aib eng yonou munon barai nob ete qamarei: yonou uberegent wes et bugom. Qen geret nonou munon qarau eng wurimaribigine yar nonou goten qanamt end igorubour.

content: End Debit wonou uyes ‘yonou munon barai’ qamar eng, bo meimet qamb Debit tumbigi?”
Ende qamara munon ger wo qob eng taui qemeriner eng misue gab wugumirei. Qen end qanambig wot yari wagomir end bo sabar me qebimau.
